page.title: Staff workspace.
page.body: Manage your public staff profile, guild operations, blacklist appeals, team applications and bot health from one place — with live bot-wide analytics for planning the next rollout.
logs.title: Live logs
logs.body: The bot's console as it is written, colour for colour. Under the supervisor the bot, the dashboard and the supervisor write to one console, so a restart does not clear it; the level and process menus filter only this page.
logs.hidePymongoHint: Keeps MongoDB's debug output out of the console.
logs.hideUrllib3Hint: Keeps urllib3's connection and retry debug output out of the console.
logs.hideWavelinkHint: Keeps wavelink's player and node debug output out of the console.
logs.empty: Nothing has been logged at this level yet.
logs.filteredEmpty: No lines match the current filters.
logs.error: The live log could not be read.
logs.unavailable: This process is not writing to the log buffer yet.
logs.truncated: Older lines have rolled out of the buffer.
honeypot.title: Honeypot hits
honeypot.body: Every probe of a decoy path is stored in the database, grouped by source address. Ban an address here and it is refused across the website, the APIs, and every subdomain.
honeypot.loadFailed: The honeypot store could not be read.
honeypot.metricHitsHint: Written to the database, not this process's memory.
honeypot.metricAddressesHint: Hits are aggregated per source address.
honeypot.metricBansHint: Manual and autoban entries that have not expired.
honeypot.guardBody: When the guard is armed, an address that crosses the threshold inside the counting window is banned for the cooldown. The ban applies everywhere immediately.
honeypot.guardScope: A ban covers the website, APIs, auth, and every subdomain.
honeypot.saveFailed: The autoban settings could not be saved.
honeypot.settingsNumbers: Enter a number for the threshold, window, and cooldown.
honeypot.hitsBody: The latest probe per address, with its count, path, host, and user agent.
honeypot.empty: No honeypot probes have been recorded yet.
honeypot.internalHint: Loopback and private addresses cannot be banned.
honeypot.banConfirm: Ban {ip} from the website, APIs, and every subdomain?
honeypot.banFailed: The address could not be banned.
honeypot.unbanFailed: The address could not be unbanned.
